acceptanceCriteria: A local check fails, naming package and path, when a test file in a declared package names a repository path literal outside that package's read-scope entries, and passes on the current tree.
The check runs in the local doc-gate list used by lanes and in CI before the confined shard runs.
The V1-1340 case (internal/cem/verify reading protocol/cem-1.0/stable/tamper-matrix/ with the entry removed) is a fixture that the check catches.
body: Observed 2026-10-13 (lane V1-1340, PR beamfall/corvint#859): a lane added protocol/cem-1.0/stable/tamper-matrix/ and a test in internal/cem/verify (a package declared in .corvint/test-read-scopes.json) that reads it. Local runs are unconfined and passed; the hosted go-product-shard run under the Landlock wrapper failed with a content-looking message ("manifest entry ... does not match the case file") because the read returned EACCES. The affected literal-reader rule (AFP-V0-021) already extracts repository path literals from test sources per package. Proposal: a local check (make target or part of unbounded-readers-check) that, for every declared package, compares the path literals its test files name against the declared read scope and fails naming the undeclared path, so the gap is caught before push. Related: V1-0633 (run the confined wrapper locally) and V1-1298 (selection fan-out on a scopes edit). Not a defect in the wrapper; the declaration grammar and enforcement behaved as specified.
title: test read scopes: fail locally when a declared package reads a repository path outside its declaration
